categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Forecam Optics Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of special and civilian optical lenses, optoelectronic systems, and optical components. Its product portfolio includes customized products mainly for aerospace, space observation, guidance, naval, aviation, and high-end equipment sectors, and non-customized products such as security monitoring lenses, automotive lenses, infrared lenses, machine vision lenses, and projection optical engines serving smart security, smart transportation, IoT, AR/VR, and intelligent manufacturing fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical design and precision manufacturing technologies including large-aperture transmissive astronomical lenses, complex zoom optical system design, multispectral coaxial lens production, miniaturized fixed and zoom aspheric lens design, and ultra-precision optical processing. It employs automated production techniques for aspheric lenses and integrates mold processing, mechanical processing, plastic injection molding, lens cold processing, and assembly/testing in a comprehensive industrial chain. The firm holds nearly 1,000 patents, including over 500 invention patents, reflecting strong R&D capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include the Chinese Academy of Sciences, major research institutes, and enterprises involved in national aerospace projects such as Shenzhou, Chang'e lunar exploration, Tianwen-1 Mars mission, and Long March rockets. The company also serves global security equipment manufacturers, automotive component suppliers, and clients in smart city, IoT, automotive networking, and AR/VR sectors. Its products are critical for national defense, aerospace, and high-end civilian applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Fuzhou, Fujian Province. It has international presence through its wholly-owned German subsidiary Innovision GmbH, which acts as a bridgehead for cooperation with European optical enterprises and serves international customers in medical, laser, photography, and imaging fields. Overseas sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, with exports to multiple countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Forecam Optics operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the optical industry supply chain. It undertakes core optical lens design, precision manufacturing, assembly, and testing, providing integrated product solutions from raw optical components to finished optical systems. The company also engages in upstream activities such as mold and precision component manufacturing, ensuring control over key production stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained high R&D investment exceeding 10% of revenue. It focuses on advancing core technologies for aerospace-grade optical systems, complex zoom lenses, multispectral imaging, and miniaturized aspheric lenses. Strategic R&D projects include large-aperture astronomical telescopes, multispectral coaxial optical systems, high-resolution infrared detectors, and Micro-LED projection engines for AR glasses. The firm emphasizes dual-use technology integration, digital transformation, and expanding international collaborations to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized and non-customized optical products. Customized products are developed and priced through negotiation or bidding with institutional clients, while non-customized products are sold directly to commercial customers based on orders. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and leasing of idle assets. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fujian Forecam Optics is a leading global manufacturer in the optical lens industry with unique competitive advantages in large-aperture astronomical lenses and high-precision zoom systems. It holds a strong position domestically as a key supplier for national aerospace and defense projects and is advancing in civilian markets such as security and automotive optics. The company competes with both domestic and international optical firms, leveraging proprietary technologies and integrated manufacturing capabilities to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 621 million, a 5.82% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.49 million. EBITDA grew by over 220% to a record high. The company maintains total assets around RMB 2.57 billion and net assets of RMB 1.7 billion. R&D expenses consistently exceed 10% of revenue, supporting sustainable growth and innovation. The firm has a stable shareholder base with over 8,600 shareholders and a market capitalization reflecting its industry stature.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fujian Forecam Optics emphasizes its unique value through advanced proprietary optical technologies, including world-first large-aperture transmissive astronomical lenses and high-zoom ratio optical systems. Its integrated industrial chain from precision mold making to final assembly ensures high product quality and customization capability. The company’s dual-use technology platform supports both military and civilian applications, providing customers with reliable, high-performance optical solutions tailored to complex and demanding environments. Its strong patent portfolio and continuous innovation underpin its competitive differentiation.
